commits.edited_message:
* src/truetype/ttvarc.c (tt_varc_get_item_deltas): Fix integer overflow.

(tt_face_load_varc_glyph): Use a conservative coordinate-stack limit.

[varc] Support static component axes.

* src/truetype/ttgxvar.c (ft_var_load_gvar): Set up a private blend for fonts with gvar but no fvar.

* src/truetype/ttvarc.c (tt_face_load_varc_glyph): Inherit private static axes and use the full 64-entry coordinate stack.

coupling: The first commit reduces VARC_STACK_COORD_COUNT from 64 to 63 and changes the stack-selection predicate to num_coords < VARC_STACK_COORD_COUNT, so its own tree safely heap-allocates every vector that can reach the 63-entry stack. The later static-axis commit changes that predicate to num_coords <= 64; with the original 64-entry stack this is benign, but combined with the earlier commit it selects the 63-entry stack for a 64-coordinate gvar font. The subsequent 64-element FT_MEM_COPY writes 512 bytes into a 504-byte stack array. Restoring either commit's local invariant removes the bug, so a correct fix must reconcile the array capacity and selection threshold across both commits.
